create_logcat_thread: create a LogcatThread instance that reads Android log entries in a separate daemon thread
add_event_listener: add an EventListener with a regexp pattern and handler function to the LogcatThread
remove_event_listener: remove a registered EventListener handler from the LogcatThread listeners dictionary
pause_resume_logcat: pause and resume the LogcatThread log stream processing and restart the thread if dead
kill_logcat_thread: kill the LogcatThread by setting the stop flag and joining the thread with a timeout
